The company

We make software.
And help it find
its customers.

Trumbull Systems LLC is a software development and publishing company based in New Britain, Connecticut.

We build web tools, subscription software and desktop applications for small and medium-sized businesses and individual users. We also work with independent developers to publish and distribute their products.

01 / Development

Our own software, from idea to release

We design, build and maintain the products we publish, including the infrastructure and services they rely on.

02 / Publishing

A route to market for independent developers

We bring product management, publishing and marketing support to developer partnerships.

03 / People

Built around a real use

Our focus is practical: helping a business reach customers or helping someone complete a task with less work.

Worldwide partnerships

You’ve built something useful.
Let’s talk about
what comes next.

We welcome independent developers and business partners from every part of the world.

If you have software ready for users, or a product that needs publishing and distribution support, tell us about it. We discuss the responsibilities and commercial terms together, then put the agreement in writing.
